stages.name: Unallocated reserve; Two Homes only after review

constraints: No campaign creation until intended ad accounts are identified.
All created campaigns must initially be PAUSED.
Do not use account spending limits that affect unrelated campaigns.
Verify account currency and reserve room for exchange-rate movement before assigning local-currency budgets.

Use a lifetime cap and end time for the Meta test. Google daily budgets alone do not enforce a $45 test cap; launch only with a supported fixed campaign total budget or another verified hard spending control.
Do not launch if protected checkout, download and purchase tracking are not verified in production.
Preserve the seven pre-existing Meta drafts.
Use one pilot country first to avoid splitting $150 across many auctions; English-speaking worldwide remains the addressable market.
Suggested first-country candidate: US, based on the observed US keyword research. Confirm account eligibility and actual CPC before launch.
Two Homes: no relationship-hardship targeting, customer-match lists, remarketing or inferred divorce-status audiences. Review current platform policy and eligibility before any launch.

meta.headline: Compare the full wedding quote
meta.primary_text: A venue price is only the starting point. Compare guest costs, extras, service fees and tax assumptions in The Wedding Decision Kit. Includes blank and example Excel files, a PDF guide and a fillable vendor worksheet. $49 USD, one payment.

meta.headline: What is still left to pay?
meta.primary_text: Keep agreed vendor totals, deposits and refunds together. The Wedding Decision Kit shows the remaining balance without subtracting a deposit from the agreed price. Excel workbooks plus a practical PDF guide. $49 USD, one payment.

headlines: See What Is Left To Pay
descriptions: Compare vendor quotes, deposits and refunds in Excel. Blank and example files. $49 USD.

google.initial_bid_plan: Manual CPC if account supports it. Candidate ceiling $0.40 USD equivalent; validate actual eligibility and bid estimates. This ceiling may deliver little or no traffic.

meta.headline: Two Homes, One Organizer
meta.primary_text: An Excel kit for planned and actual handovers, factual notes, shared expense allocations and practical contacts. Includes fictional examples and fillable A4 and US Letter forms. A personal organizer, not legal advice. $49 USD, one payment.

meta.headline: Make the expense split clear
meta.primary_text: Record shared expenses, the split in an existing arrangement, reimbursements and refunds in one Excel kit. Two Homes, One Organizer includes blank and example workbooks plus practical PDF forms. $49 USD, one payment.

measurement.conversions: Server-verified, captured purchases; distinguish ad-platform attribution from payment records.
stop_rules: Stop immediately for broken payment, download, duplicate charging or privacy issues.
At $20 spend without a checkout initiation, pause and inspect the landing page, search terms, traffic quality and tracking.
At $40 spend with zero verified purchases, pause that test for diagnosis; do not automatically consume the reserve.
Do not declare a winner from one sale. Record refunds, support questions and whether buyers can use the files.
measurement.revenue_note: 2041 purchases at $49 = $100,009 gross revenue before advertising, fees, refunds, support and tax. No sales or profit forecast is implied.
